canonical_source_decision.rationale: Bitstamp had perfect continuity and no material persistent close-price bias versus Coinbase, but source choice changed strategy-relevant outcomes. Bitstamp alone created one swing and its breakout, failed to create a validator-consensus swing/reclaim sequence, and missed a 107270 stop that both validators hit during the 10 October 2025 selloff. Maximum MFE and MAE sensitivities were 2.433 and 4.605 percentage points. Those rare but consequential range differences make the isolated-wick risk unacceptable for a sole V1 canonical structural reference without a separate cross-venue confirmation or composite policy.
